enable_edge_ai_synthesis.description: Administrative kill-switch for client-side Edge AI Discharge Summary synthesis (Gemini Nano / window.ai). Set to 'false' to disable clinical AI generation.

enable_batch_purge.description: Administrative kill-switch for batch patient data purging (Purge Discharged / Purge All). Set to 'false' to hide purge controls across manager consoles.

version.description: Initial 2026 Remote Config template for IMC Unified Command Center (enable_edge_ai_synthesis & enable_batch_purge kill-switches)
